purpose: test whether exact ordered interactions through K=3 provide a meaningful improvement over K=2 on four-stage Pythia chronology before any held-out confirmation codebook is observed
basis_probe_policy: measure the exact ordered interaction basis through degree 3 once and score both K=2 and K=3 from the same lower-order tensors
validation_policy: evaluate every one of the 24 A/B/C/D permutations as held-out four-stage endpoints

stage_randomness.rule: reset the stage-specific seed on every stage-map invocation so stochasticity cannot encode macro position or candidate order
